sections.title: How the years are used
sections.note: How the agent uses the innings, by calendar year: every candidate model is judged on three check years, each by a model that learned only from the years before it, and the latest year is kept for a single final test.

sections.title: Test population
sections.note: The innings the agent is judged on: every IPL and BBL innings, and the T20 internationals where both teams are ICC full members. Every check year and the test year are scored on these innings only.

sections.title: Excluded, and why
sections.note: These choices were made before the agent runs, when the data was prepared by the script scripts/prepare_data.py. The agent does not decide what to exclude: it only ever sees the innings that were kept.
